title: Separate Query from Modifier

solutions.title: A pure lookup plus an explicit hold
solutions.tradeoff: Two calls where there was one, and the caller that genuinely always wants both now has to make that sequence itself instead of getting it for free - which is also the one place a real concurrent box office would need the two calls to be atomic again, at the datastore rather than in this module.

reviewFocus: Does `nextAvailableSeat` still read cleanly as a question - no branch in it ever assigns to a seat's `status` or `heldBy`?

Did `nextSeatQuote` and `sectionHasAvailability` stop passing a placeholder customer id once they moved onto the query? A caller still inventing an id like "quote" is the tell that the split isn't finished.
Is `holdNextAvailableSeat` still one function, or did the split leak into forcing every caller to call the query and the modifier separately even when a caller genuinely wants both?
Does `tests-fixed/` prove the one thing that changed - that quoting or checking availability no longer holds a seat - without also depending on anything `tests/` already pins?
Does the walkthrough name the case where this split is the wrong move - a query-and-modify pair that has to stay atomic - and say what makes this one different from that case?
